description: Fresh snapshot, matching span, and matching PubMed paper identity are accepted.
A registered cached source without a fresh fetch/local_pdf event is rejected.
A snapshot whose text no longer matches its hashes is a hard integrity failure.
A span naming a non-existent source_id is rejected.
A PubMed-keyed artifact backed by a snapshot without PMID/DOI/PMCID is rejected.
A pre-kernel extraction with factual fields but no spans is unverified, not accepted.
Agent-written excerpt text that differs from the snapshot re-slice is rejected.
